command_line:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
counts_file <- args[1]
metadata_file <- args[2]
result_file <- args[3]
count_file <- args[4]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

counts_df <- read.table(counts_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 3) stop("Count table must contain gene IDs and sample columns")
if (anyDuplicated(counts_df[[1]]) > 0) stop("Duplicate gene IDs in count table")
gene_ids <- counts_df[[1]]
count_mat_all <- as.matrix(counts_df[, -1, drop = FALSE])
rownames(count_mat_all) <- gene_ids
storage.mode(count_mat_all) <- "integer"

meta <- read.delim(metadata_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE, quote = "")
required <- c("sample", "condition", "sex")
if (!all(required %in% names(meta))) stop(paste("Metadata missing columns:", paste(setdiff(required, names(meta)), collapse = ",")))
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$sample) & meta$sample != "", required, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[meta$condition %in% c("ASXL1", "Control") & meta$sex %in% c("M", "F"), , drop = FALSE]
if (anyDuplicated(meta$sample) > 0) stop("Duplicate sample IDs in metadata")
matched <- meta$sample[meta$sample %in% colnames(count_mat_all)]
if (length(matched) == 0) stop("No metadata samples match count columns")
meta <- meta[match(matched, meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
count_mat <- count_mat_all[, meta$sample, drop = FALSE]
if (!identical(colnames(count_mat), meta$sample)) stop("Sample order mismatch after matching")

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
meta$sex <- factor(meta$sex)
rownames(meta) <- meta$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat, colData = meta, design = ~ sex + condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "ASXL1", "Control"), alpha = 0.05)
res_df <- as.data.frame(res[order(res$padj), ])
res_df$geneID <- rownames(res_df)
res_df <- res_df[, c("geneID", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "stat", "pvalue", "padj")]
write.table(res_df, file = result_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

sig_count <- sum(!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < 0.05)
meta_lines <- c(
  paste("significant_padj_lt_0.05", sig_count, sep = "\t"),
  paste("deseq2_version", as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), sep = "\t"),
  paste("analysis_samples", ncol(count_mat), sep = "\t"),
  paste("excluded_count_columns", paste(setdiff(colnames(count_mat_all), meta$sample), collapse = ","), sep = "\t"),
  paste("design", "~ sex + condition", sep = "\t"),
  paste("contrast", "ASXL1_vs_Control", sep = "\t"),
  paste("results_alpha", "0.05", sep = "\t"),
  paste("apeglm_available", requireNamespace("apeglm", quietly = TRUE), sep = "\t")
)
writeLines(meta_lines, con = count_file)
